About Organization

Consortium of National Law Universities is a group of top law universities in **India**. The consortium is responsible for conducting the CLAT admission test.
The consortium aims to provide a common platform for law aspirants to get admission to top law universities in **India**.

About the Programme

The CLAT 2027 admission test is a national-level exam conducted by the Consortium of National Law Universities. The exam is conducted to provide admission to UG and PG law programs in top law universities in **India**.
The program aims to provide a fair and transparent admission process for law aspirants.
